sparkline.sparkline.editData.note: U:grid/data: Excel's Edit Sparklines (Data Range, Location Range) for the sparkline in the active cell; gridcraft has single sparklines only (no groups), so Edit Group Location & Data and Hidden & Empty Cells are left out. Checked against gridcraft (insert_sparkline replaces by location).

sparkline.type.line.note: U:grid/data: changes the kind of the sparkline in the active cell (gridcraft Sparkline.kind).

sparkline.type.column.note: U:grid/data: changes the kind of the sparkline in the active cell (gridcraft Sparkline.kind).

sparkline.type.winLoss.note: U:grid/data: changes the kind of the sparkline in the active cell (gridcraft Sparkline.kind).

sparkline.group.clear.note: U:grid/data: removes the sparkline in the active cell (gridcraft has no groups, so Clear Selected Sparklines and Clear Selected Sparkline Groups are one).
